redirects: Existing zone-level HTTPS and www-to-apex rules. web/_redirects is preserved as historical hosting configuration, not uploaded as a public asset.
deployment_strategy: Upload once, test immutable version URL, promote same version at 100 percent
rollback: Restore the predecessor version at 100 percent if identity or functional smoke checks fail
credentials: Connected Cloudflare API; temporary asset upload JWTs never enter the repository
